steward_relevance: Carrier AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile allowed unauthorized SIM swaps enabling interception of calls, account takeovers, and communications fraud. § 1798.81.5 duty to implement reasonable security + § 1798.82 notification duty are the California civil causes of action for these carriers.
first_step_triage: Identify each carrier (AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile), dates of SIM swap events, what personal information was accessed or intercepted. Map to § 1798.81.5 (failure to implement reasonable authentication) and § 1798.82 (failure to notify). § 1798.84 private right of action for breach of § 1798.82.
